_comment: The labelling node for this skills directory (bean 9umr; #980: nesting is described from within). Each topic is a subdirectory that HOLDS packages; a package keeps its own name, which is what skill_fetch takes. Read by scripts/skill-topics.ts, which descends only into the topics named here and refuses one that does not exist. Declare a topic only once it holds a package. `directories` names the subgraphs declared INSIDE skills/ that are not topic packages (bean `cmsl`): today one, `voices`, which arrived from agent-skills on 2026-10-01 (bean `j7ql`).

topics.title: Knowledge graph
topics.description: How the graph is declared, placed, read, restructured, exported and audited.

topics.title: Library and information management
topics.description: How sources are acquired, ingested, archived, catalogued and described.

topics.title: Rendering, UI and publication surfaces
topics.description: How the corpus is rendered, published and presented: the docs site, viewers, boards, themes, and their QC.

topics.title: Agent conduct
topics.description: How an agent behaves in the harness: interaction, confirmation, memory, security, and what it may and may not do on its own.

topics.title: Process model and execution
topics.description: How work is modelled and run: BPMN and DMN, roles and authorization, RACI, methodologies, and the workflow engine's state.

topics.title: Content authoring and content QA
topics.description: How content is written, reviewed and validated: the content-type adapters, the content lifecycle, editorial and voice review, and domain authoring (math, WHO SMART guidelines).

topics.title: Software delivery practice
topics.description: How work is planned, claimed, reviewed, merged, released and coordinated: the work plan, issues and PRs, CI and gates, requirements (CRDM, spec-kit), and multi-session coordination.

directories.description: `folio-voice/v1` profiles read out of this instance's `library/`: the shared base `agent-skill-authoring` plus one override per agent vendor, on the owner's ruling of 2026-09-20: 'for model specific sources, make those model specific voices.' Arrived from agent-skills on 2026-10-01 when that instance dissolved into cat-harness's concern groups (bean `j7ql`); the corpus they cite came with them, so citations stay INTERNAL (no `instance:` key). The rules are deliberately NOT formally constrained: owner, 2026-09-20, 'preference leave unstructured schema, agentic review b/c of best practice drift, not formal' — published best practice is revised without notice, so a schema gate would pin whichever vintage was current when it was written. VENDOR OVERRIDES live in the reserved `vendors/` sub-sub-graph inside this directory — `voices/vendors/<id>/voice.json` — declared from within by `voices/voices.json` and `voices/vendors/vendors.json` (owner, 2026-09-22 and bean `rkqp`). A vendor voice still declares what it overrides in its own `extends` field, so nothing infers the relation from a path.
